data_audit.eval_design: Gold-conditioned balanced binary query-skill relevance pairs; not a retrieval-ranked shortlist. Evaluate fixed identical pairs before/after. family_exposure.definition: Connected components over union of official train/test skills, exact repository string OR stripped lowercase exact skill name; diagnostic computation, not a new split.
family_exposure.conclusion: No certified blind or family-unexposed holdout. Existing grouped train/dev supports a disclosed within-experiment diagnostic only. Historical 256-query dev belongs to different revision and its exact IDs were not supplied by the examined ledger.

recommendation.data: Reuse existing train512/dev128 grouping; select bounded training query prefix and preserve every qrel edge for every selected query. Include each query only if every gold skill is retained.
recommendation.negatives: Sample only train_allowed_skill_ids minus the complete per-query official gold set. Never truncate a mixed examples list after constructing positives.
recommendation.tiny_eval: Freeze first 4 or 8 existing dev128 IDs before scoring. Include all positives plus a fixed small nonpositive set per query, label as gold-conditioned binary relevance diagnostic; or use first4 existing lora-hard dev_pools unmodified for honest retrieval reranking diagnostic. Evaluate exactly same pairs/pools baseline and adapted. No blind/test/generalization claims.
recommendation.metrics: Pair-level CE+Brier, positive vs negative probability separation, paired score differences; for unmodified frozen pools include candidate recall ceiling and macro MRR/NDCG/Recall with all official gold denominators.

guard_observation_limitations: Guard performs assertions before appending a failing snapshot. Inspect guard-stop.json sample/previous fields when available; the first pilot guard-stop predates those extra fields, so its violating snapshot is absent from telemetry.
CPU streaks count unique host timestamps, not duplicate polling snapshots.
Guest pswpin/pswpout changes measure active guest swap; host paging counters were not present in host monitor schema.
Recorded process exit alone does not certify full PC release. Generator requires explicit pc_released:true for that claim.

guest_swap_across_run_span.interpretation: Cumulative counter differences span gaps between runs as well as runs. Per-run zero deltas do not erase an earlier active-swap guard stop.

data_audit.family_definition: Connected components over combined train/test skill catalogs using exact repository OR stripped lowercase exact name.
excluded_train_family_sources: All128 prior local adaptation dev positive families
All4392 historically exposed public-test query positive families
data_audit.negative_method: One unique deterministic SHA256-ranked non-gold negative per positive; all official gold excluded. Train negatives additionally within original train_allowed_skill_ids and outside every forbidden family. Eval negatives from forbidden families to guarantee every actual candidate family is disjoint.
data_audit.rendered_text: Selected skill name, description, body fields each retain first4000 characters; query text unchanged. Training tokenizer applies its own separately reported token bound.
data_audit.exposure: Exposed development diagnostic; not blind, not a pristine final test, and not proof of pretrained-model generalization. Historic256 dev IDs at a different dataset revision are unavailable in the examined exposure ledger; no absence-of-exposure claim.
data_audit.eval_design: Gold-conditioned balanced binary query-skill relevance pairs; not a retrieval-ranked shortlist. Evaluate fixed identical pairs before/after. CE+Brier, score separation and threshold accuracy are diagnostics; pair balancing and explicit gold insertion invalidate full-corpus retrieval claims.
